title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A WAREHOUSE ON THE CUSTOM-HOUSE GROUNDS, MANILA, AND THE GRADING AND PAVING OF A CERTAIN PART OF THOSE GROUNDS.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A WAREHOUSE ON THE CUSTOM-HOUSE GROUNDS, MANILA, AND THE GRADING AND PAVING OF A CERTAIN PART OF THOSE GROUNDS.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The Military Governor is authorized and directed to construct a warehouse on the grounds of the
custom-house, Manila, extending along Calle Numancia, Calle de Urbiztondo and Custom-House Road, in
accordance with the plans entitled, "New bodega for the custom-house at Manila, P. I.," with the
accompanying specifications, issued from the office of the assistant chief quartermaster, Manila, October
twenty-second, nineteen hundred.

The Military Governor is authorized and directed to grade and pave that part of the custom-house
grounds lying between the outer line of the proposed warehouse and the streets along which it extends.

The work hereinbefore authorized and directed shall be done by contract to be awarded to the
lowest responsible bidder, after bids have been invited by public advertisement. Authority is hereby given to
the Military Governor to reject and and all bids; Provided, however, That should no satisfactory bid be
received in public competition, he is authorized to let the work by private contract, or to do the work by
government employees without contract.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 31, 1900.
